decisions.basis: Pair-0007 dossier: exact CollisionAvoidance composite binding, NL3 clause, three triggered owner-local initial edges, four projected region slots, and the inspection diagnostic reporting no unconditional owner entry.
decisions.reason: NL3 requires the orthogonal regions of the active collision-avoidance mode to support concurrent activation. The exact CollisionAvoidance composite has four projected region slots, and its three authored initial transitions at lines 38, 40, and 42 all carry event triggers. The supplied inspection fact reports that no unconditional default owner entry exists. A compatible alternative is to read NL3 as requiring only structural region declarations, which the model preserves; that alternative is supported by the exact composite and transition bindings, so the first operational-entry reading remains semantically undercut rather than eliminated.
decisions.strongest_defeater: NL3 may be read as a structural requirement for named concurrent regions without requiring an unconditional operational entry into the composite.
decisions.violated_obligation: The active collision-avoidance mode must provide orthogonal regions with operational owner entry sufficient for concurrent activation of the collision-avoidance controls.

decisions.basis: Pair-0007 dossier: exact NL2 source mapping, CollisionAvoidance binding, finite root-reachability facts, and the supplied G1 plan and unsupported receipt.
decisions.reason: NL2 states that the sub-machine becomes active after the specified collision detections. The exact source/model binding maps that sub-machine to CollisionAvoidance, and the supplied finite reachability facts state that CollisionAvoidance is not reachable from the top-level initial entry. The declaration of an incoming CollisionDetection-to-CollisionAvoidance transition does not establish root reachability because the supplied facts also mark its source scope unreachable. No competent alternative reading is supported by the dossier; the unsupported G1 execution route does not alter the exact semantic facts.
decisions.violated_obligation: CollisionAvoidance must be reachable from the model root so that the NL2 activation behavior can occur.

decisions.basis: Pair-0007 dossier: exact NL2 event-activation contract, bound event consumers for the three collision events, reachability facts showing empty reachable-consumer sets, and unsupported predicate route.
decisions.reason: NL2 requires the collision-avoidance sub-machine to become active after any of the three specified collision-detection events. The exact model facts show declared consumers targeting FrontendCollision, RearendCollision, and PedestrianCollision, but PossibleCollision and CollisionAvoidance are unreachable and all three consumers have empty reachable-consumer sets. Declaration and endpoint presence do not establish the required operational activation, and no supplied fact supports a competing reading that would make unreachable declarations sufficient.
decisions.violated_obligation: Each specified collision-detection event must lead operationally to activation of the CollisionAvoidance sub-machine.

decisions.basis: Pair-0007 dossier: exact NL1 cardinality binding, explicit canonical region identifiers, source separators, four-region inventory, and the supplied primary concurrent-region reading.
